subject: spacing of labels on y axis

messages.author: 96e630cb74e1964d
messages.subject: spacing of labels on y axis
parts:
Hello:

I am making some boxplots. Is there a way to increase the spacing
between the y axis labels and the axis itself?

Thank you.

Michael

messages.author: 96e630cb74e1964d
messages.subject: Re: spacing of labels on y axis
parts:
I am sorry, here is my simple code:

p <- ggplot(ganges_annualpre,aes(x = period, y = MEAN)) +
ylab("Precipitation (mm)") + opts(title = "Ganges Basin Mean Annual
Precipitation") + scale_colour_grey()


p + geom_boxplot(linetype = 2, colour = "navyblue") +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.text.y =
theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.ticks =
theme_segment(colour = "white"))

ggsave(file = "ganges mean annual precip.png", height = 5.5, width =
5.5)

Cheers,

Michael

messages.subject: Re: spacing of labels on y axis
parts:
Hi Michael,

You probably want to right align the labels:

opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(colour = "black", hjust = 1))

Hadley
